The '''Oracaia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Oracaian customs frigate]] was from this system.<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Oracaian customs frigate]]|system=Oracaia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>
